title: Credit Card Four-Key USB Macro Pad

GND.rationale: Two-layer return plane for USB power, display, keys, and analog audio.

VBUS.rationale: USB 5 V from the XIAO module and LCD backlight supply.

V3V3.rationale: XIAO-regulated 3.3 V logic and microphone rail.

LCD_MOSI.rationale: Short, board-local ST7789P3 SPI data trace; no controlled-impedance requirement in this revision.

LCD_SCK.rationale: Short, board-local ST7789P3 SPI clock; keep away from the microphone block and route over continuous ground.

LCD_LEDA.rationale: Resistor-limited LCD backlight current is below 120 mA; ordinary 0.5 mm power routing is sufficient for this short run.

MIC_RAW.rationale: ZTS6216 analog output before AC coupling. The MIC1 footprint owns a same-pin, soldermask-covered copper escape tongue around the mandatory acoustic port; outside the footprint the net retains the sensitive_analog class.

MIC_AC.rationale: AC-coupled microphone signal biased at VBIAS.

VBIAS.rationale: Filtered 1.65 V virtual ground for the preamplifier.

MIC_FB.rationale: TLV9061 feedback node; minimize loop area.

MIC_AMP.rationale: Amplified microphone signal before anti-alias resistor.

MIC_ADC.rationale: Filtered ADC input to XIAO D8.

stitchingVias.name: GND_STITCH_BIAS
stitchingVias.rationale: Bridges the diagnosed bottom GND filled-polygon lobe spanning x=3.993..8.371 mm, y=16.951..20.928 mm to the continuous top GND pour.

stitchingVias.name: GND_STITCH_DISPLAY_CENTER
stitchingVias.rationale: Bridges the diagnosed bottom GND filled-polygon lobe spanning x=-21.675..14.883 mm, y=8.874..19.864 mm to the continuous top GND pour.

stitchingVias.name: GND_STITCH_MAIN
stitchingVias.rationale: Connects the main bottom GND filled polygon to the main top GND pour at an open, geometry-probed board-center location.

keepouts.name: OUTER_EDGE_COPPER_KEEPOUT_LEFT
keepouts.rationale: Preserves the product's 1 mm routed-copper clearance at the external left board edge while the global floor accommodates MIC1's internal acoustic drill.

keepouts.name: OUTER_EDGE_COPPER_KEEPOUT_RIGHT
keepouts.rationale: Preserves the product's 1 mm routed-copper clearance at the external right board edge while the global floor accommodates MIC1's internal acoustic drill.

keepouts.name: OUTER_EDGE_COPPER_KEEPOUT_TOP
keepouts.rationale: Preserves the product's 1 mm routed-copper clearance at the external top board edge while the global floor accommodates MIC1's internal acoustic drill.

keepouts.name: OUTER_EDGE_COPPER_KEEPOUT_BOTTOM
keepouts.rationale: Preserves the product's 1 mm routed-copper clearance at the external bottom board edge while the global floor accommodates MIC1's internal acoustic drill.

keepouts.name: U1_ANTENNA_COPPER_KEEPOUT
keepouts.rationale: Keep carrier copper clear beneath the XIAO ESP32S3 antenna end.

allowedOverlaps.rationale: J1_GND_ESCAPE is a soldermask-covered same-net copper tongue intentionally overlapping only J1 pin 2; it is not a second assembled body.
U2_GND_ESCAPE is soldermask-covered same-net copper and a source-owned GND via overlapping U2 pin 2; it is not a second assembled body.
